name: patchwork-commit-composer
description: Split one large change into small, meaningful commits. Patchwork groups changed hunks with an LLM, writes commit messages, and lets you review every commit before it touches git.
author: Assone

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.app.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.unit.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit
scripts.pretest: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run compile-tests && pnpm run compile && pnpm run lint
scripts.test: pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run test:integration

patchwork.llm.provider.markdownDescription: Which LLM provider to call. `openai-compatible` covers any endpoint that speaks the OpenAI wire format (Ollama, vLLM, DeepSeek, OpenRouter, Groq, LM Studio, Azure OpenAI).

patchwork.llm.model.markdownDescription: Model id for the chosen provider, e.g. `gpt-4o`, `claude-sonnet-4-5`, `qwen2.5-coder:7b`.

patchwork.llm.baseURL.markdownDescription: Endpoint root for `openai-compatible` providers, e.g. `http://localhost:11434/v1` (Ollama) or `https://api.deepseek.com/v1`. Ignored for `openai` and `anthropic`.

patchwork.llm.chat-completions.markdownDescription: Wire format for `openai-compatible` endpoints. `chat-completions` is the common case; switch to `responses` for Azure OpenAI.

patchwork.llm.idleTimeoutSeconds.markdownDescription: Abort a request when the provider sends **no data** for this many seconds. Every streamed chunk resets the timer, so a long but healthy generation is never cut off. Raise this if a slow local model takes a long time to produce its first token.

patchwork.commits.runHooks.markdownDescription: Run the repository's git commit hooks by committing through `git commit` with a temporary index. This disables the atomic writer: if a hook fails mid-plan, earlier commits may already exist. Signing follows `commit.gpgSign` in both modes.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Patchwork reads repository state and writes commits, so it requires a trusted workspace.
